taxon_match.method: Reviewed original TAXA_ID and common-name identity with exact case-normalized scientific name; historical reference corroboration retained.

geography_match.method: Unique complete site/date/visit/state join to active publisher STATECTY FIPS and county name; original distinct UID values retained. Gross geographic contradictions held.

temporal_scope: Positive sample dates span 2019-04-28 through 2019-04-28; independently selected primary date 2019-04-28.
spatial_scope: Sampled locations in the publisher-reported county; no countywide prevalence claim.
survey_scope: Distinct positive fish counts from 2018/2019 Target_Sampled visits with unqualified fish sampling status. Effort sufficiency remains a caveat, and county inventory completeness is not inferred.
caveats: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, National Rivers and Streams Assessment2018/2019 fish counts, sampling information and site information; official2013/2014 and2023/2024 taxon reference files and2018 field manual.
Historical positive reports at sampled sites only. Retrieval does not establish current survival, countywide prevalence or a complete inventory.
Absence, non-detection and protocol completion cannot be inferred from missing rows, counts, effort flags or held identities.
Fish UID differs from sampling/site UID in this release. Unique complete site/date/visit/state joins and sampling/site UID agreement are required; original values are never rewritten.

Publisher county geography is authoritative only when current FIPS/name/state match and the independent geography review has no material contradiction. Frame points and river borders diagnose conflicts; they do not assign an alternative county.

The original primary receipt path was overwritten during supplementary acquisition. Fresh six-file reacquisition receipts and exact original-body parity are retained; overwritten receipt history is not reconstructed.
Independent agent proposals are not canonical completed worker manifests or human specimen verification. MAIN method adoption and canonical run checks supply separate acceptance.
notes: Exact original fish, sampling, site and taxon row witnesses are retained in epa-nrsa-1819-fish-witnesses.json.
